question: Should ClawSweeper automatically reduce all background review lanes to 16 workers under congestion and 4 under saturation based on fresh public exact-review telemetry?
rationale: The thresholds trade broad-review freshness for exact-review latency and are an operational policy choice that tests cannot settle; maintainers must own the intended balance and rollback trigger.

options.title: Guarded 16/4 rollout
options.body: Add snapshot-freshness protection, deploy telemetry first, and approve the proposed caps only after live producer-to-scheduler proof and rollback monitoring are available.

options.title: Choose different caps
options.body: Keep the pressure mechanism but select less aggressive limits or lane-specific thresholds based on an explicit throughput target.

options.title: Keep current scheduling
options.body: Decline adaptive throttling and retain the existing worker-budget scheduler until production data supports a policy change.

recommendation.title: Guarded 16/4 rollout
recommendation.body: Add snapshot-freshness protection, deploy telemetry first, and approve the proposed caps only after live producer-to-scheduler proof and rollback monitoring are available.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository operating policy makes Peter the best available owner for live scheduler safety and throughput decisions.
